name: Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior
summary: Gravitational force to apply to an item.
description:
A gravity behavior configures the gravity vector of one or more items. To define a gravity
behavior:

  1. Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createGravityBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createGravityBehavior) method to create and define the behavior.
  2. To define a gravity vector, either set the
     [angle](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior#angle) and
     [magnitude](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior#magnitude) properties, or set the
     [gravityDirection](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior#gravityDirection) property.
  3. Use the [addItem](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior#addItem) method to add items to the behavior.
  4. Add the behavior to an [Animator object](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Animator).

You can only define one gravity behavior per animator.

examples.title: Simple Example

properties.name: angle
properties.summary: Specifies the angle of the gravity vector in radians.
properties.description:
To configure the gravity vector, you need to also specify the
[magnitude](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior#magnitude) property.

properties.name: gravityDirection
properties.summary: Specifies the direction of the gravity vector as an x, y pair.
properties.description:
For example, specifiying `{x: 0.0, y: 1.0}` indicates a downward gravity force of 1000
points per second squared.

properties.name: magnitude
properties.summary: Specifies the magnitude of the gravity vector.
properties.description:
A value of 1.0 represents an acceleration of 1000 points per second squared.

To configure the gravity vector, you need to also specify the
[angle](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.GravityBehavior#angle) property.

methods.name: addItem
methods.summary: Adds an item to this behavior.

parameters.name: item
parameters.summary: View object to add to the behavior.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.summary: Removes the specified item from this behavior.
